# Rowan of Crossovers (`rowan-of-crossovers`)

Medicare-to-Medicaid crossovers for dual-eligible nursing-home residents: coinsurance never crossed over, crossovers billed for the wrong amount, no Medicaid response, underpaid or zero-paid crossovers checked against the lesser-of rule, and unpaid cost sharing for the Medicare bad debt log. Resident identifiers are masked before results reach the model.

**Rowan never submits claims to Medicaid.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Billing and revenue cycle · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y rowan-of-crossovers demo
npx -y rowan-of-crossovers mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional Cedar Hollow dual-eligible residents, reviewed on 30 April 2026 with a Medicaid rate of 210 a day. Planted:

- R1201: Medicare paid 10 March and no crossover was ever sent.
- R1202: Medicaid paid nothing, which matches lesser-of, so the full coinsurance goes to the bad debt log.
- R1203: Medicare paid only 2400, so lesser-of says Medicaid owes 3480, but it paid nothing.
- R1204: the crossover billed 600 less than the coinsurance.
- R1205: the crossover was sent 12 March with no answer.
- R1206 is not dual eligible, and R1207's Medicare payment is only 10 days old, so both are left alone.
- R1208: Medicaid paid part of it, and the rest goes to the bad debt log.

[`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) misspells a setting, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `rowan_check` | Match Medicare cost sharing to Medicaid crossovers and list what is missing, wrong or unpaid. | runs |
| `rowan_write_report` | Write rowan-crossovers.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and rowan-crossovers.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/rowan). | runs |
| `rowan_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `rowan_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `rowan_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `rowan_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `crossover_submit` | Rowan never submits claims to Medicaid. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `rowan_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `medicare` (required) | Medicare claims or remits for residents under --root: claim id, service dates, days, Medicare paid, coinsurance, deductible, paid date, dual eligible flag |
| `crossovers` (required) | Medicaid crossover claims under --root: Medicare claim id, billed coinsurance, Medicaid paid, paid date, billed date |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: wait_days, response_days, medicaid_rate, lesser_of |
| `as_of` | Date to age from (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx rowan-of-crossovers inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Medicare claims (`medicare`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |
| `resident_name` | text (masked) | Resident, Resident Name, Name, Patient, Patient Name, Client Name, Resident Full Name |
| `claim_id` (required) | text | Claim ID, Claim #, ICN, Medicare ICN, Claim Number, Original Claim, Medicare Claim |
| `from` | date | From, Start, Start Date, Effective Date, Begin Date, From Date, Admit Date, Service From |
| `to` | date | To, End, End Date, Thru, Through, Thru Date, Through Date, To Date |
| `days` | number | Days, Covered Days, Units |
| `medicare_paid` | amount | Medicare Paid, Paid, Paid Amount, Payment |
| `coinsurance` (required) | amount | Coinsurance, Coins, Co-insurance, Patient Responsibility, PR Amount |
| `deductible` | amount | Deductible, Ded |
| `paid_on` | date | Paid On, Paid Date, Remit Date, Check Date |
| `dual` | text | Dual, Dual Eligible, Medicaid Secondary, QMB |

### Medicaid crossovers (`crossovers`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` (required) | text | Claim ID, Claim #, ICN, Medicare ICN, Claim Number, Original Claim, Medicare Claim |
| `billed_coinsurance` | amount | Billed Coinsurance, Billed, Crossover Billed, Billed Amount |
| `paid_amount` | amount | Paid, Paid Amount, Medicaid Paid |
| `paid_on` | date | Paid On, Paid Date, Remit Date |
| `billed_on` | date | Billed On, Sent, Submitted, Crossover Date |

## Settings file (`rowan_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wait_days` | Days after the Medicare payment before a missing crossover is flagged (default 30) |
| `response_days` | Days to wait for a Medicaid response to a crossover (default 45) |
| `medicaid_rate` | Your Medicaid daily rate, for the lesser-of check |
| `lesser_of` | Whether your state pays crossovers lesser-of (default true) |

## Memory

`rowan_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `rowan_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `state_crossover_rule` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "rowan-of-crossovers": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "rowan-of-crossovers",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add rowan-of-crossovers -- npx -y rowan-of-crossovers mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
rowan-of-crossovers tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
rowan-of-crossovers sources               # the columns each input is read from
rowan-of-crossovers inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
rowan-of-crossovers call rowan_check '{"medicare":"<medicare>","crossovers":"<crossovers>"}'
rowan-of-crossovers eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
rowan-of-crossovers demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
